# AIFoundry.sh x402 Gateway — AI Agent Services & API Documentation

> **Title:** AIFoundry.sh x402 Pay-Per-Call Edge Gateway & Multi-Chain AI Service Marketplace
> **Protocol Standard:** x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required for Autonomous AI Agents)
> **Default Price per Tool Call:** $0.05 USDC (or equivalent crypto asset)
> **Primary Beneficiary Treasury Wallet:** `0x003cC678764C8143a4b92370acB40e3B41319016`
> **Gateway Base URL:** `https://aifoundry.pages.dev` (or `https://gateway.aifoundry.sh`)

---

## 1. Executive Overview for Autonomous LLMs & AI Agents

AIFoundry.sh provides a high-throughput, sub-20ms edge gateway running on Cloudflare Workers that enables autonomous AI agents to purchase specialized developer tools, AI code reviews, software architecture blueprints, security audits, zero-knowledge encryption, and LLM inference on a strict **pay-per-call ($0.05 USDC)** basis.

Agents interact with the gateway using the **x402 Protocol Header (`X-402-Payment`)**. When an agent makes an unpaid request to any tool endpoint, the gateway responds with `HTTP 402 Payment Required` along with payment instructions containing the price ($0.05 USDC), the beneficiary address, and supported chain configurations. Once the agent attaches a valid transaction hash or proof to the request header, the edge gateway executes the underlying AI pipeline and returns the result in JSON format.

---

## 2. Quick API Reference

| Endpoint | Method | Payment Required | Price | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /v1/tools` | GET | Free | $0.00 | List all available AI tools & pricing |
| `GET /v1/vaults` | GET | Free | $0.00 | List all 16 multi-chain payment treasury wallets |
| `GET /v1/plan` | GET | Free | $0.00 | Calculate prepaid deposit token caps & time limits |
| `GET /v1/report` | GET / POST | Free / Optional | $0.00 | System telemetry report, audit ledger & receipt generator |
| `GET /.well-known/x402` | GET | Free | $0.00 | x402 protocol machine-readable JSON manifest |
| `POST /v1/tools/openspec.plan` | POST | Required (`X-402-Payment`) | $0.05 | Software Architecture & Multi-Agent Plan Generator |
| `POST /v1/tools/review.kimi` | POST | Required (`X-402-Payment`) | $0.05 | Alibaba Open Code Review & Token Receipt Meter |
| `POST /v1/tools/audit.cf` | POST | Required (`X-402-Payment`) | $0.05 | Cloudflare Workers Security & Wrangler Auditor |
| `POST /v1/tools/crypto.vault` | POST | Required (`X-402-Payment`) | $0.05 | Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC ML-KEM-768 Kyber) Vault Guard |
| `POST /v1/tools/design.402` | POST | Required (`X-402-Payment`) | $0.05 | OpenDesign UI Spec & Tailwind Token Generator |
| `POST /v1/tools/nemotron.chat` | POST | Required (`X-402-Payment`) | $0.05 | Workers AI Edge Model LLM Proxy |

## 3. Detailed Tool Specifications & Capabilities

### Tool 1: OpenSpec Software Architecture Plan Generator (`/v1/tools/openspec.plan`)
- **Provider:** Fission AI OpenSpec + DeepSeek R1 Reasoning Model
- **Price:** $0.05 USDC
- **Functionality:** Accepts a software system goal or prompt and generates a complete, production-grade software architecture document, including system modules, database schemas, API specs, multi-agent developer team roles, persona specifications, and business unit economics.
- **Request Body JSON:**
  ```json
  {
    "goal": "Build an AI monetized web scraper and markdown generator on Cloudflare Workers",
    "architecture_style": "microservices",
    "target_cloud": "Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2"
  }
  ```
- **Response Output JSON:** Contains `architecture_plan`, `system_diagram`, `roles_breakdown`, `business_model`, and `openspec_yaml`.

---

### Tool 2: Alibaba Open Code Review & Token Meter (`/v1/tools/review.kimi`)
- **Provider:** Alibaba Open Code Review + Kimi AST Tokenizer
- **Price:** $0.05 USDC
- **Functionality:** Performs AST-level static code analysis on provided source code, detecting security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, code smells, and exact token consumption receipts.
- **Request Body JSON:**
  ```json
  {
    "code": "async function handleAuth(req) { const token = req.headers.get('Authorization'); ... }",
    "language": "javascript",
    "check_security": true
  }
  ```
- **Response Output JSON:** Contains `review_summary`, `issues_found`, `security_score`, `token_receipt` (input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated_cogs_usd), and `suggested_patches`.

---

### Tool 3: Cloudflare Workers Security Audit (`/v1/tools/audit.cf`)
- **Provider:** Cloudflare Security Audit Skill Engine
- **Price:** $0.05 USDC
- **Functionality:** Audits `wrangler.json` / `wrangler.toml` files and Worker source code against Cloudflare best practices, flagging exposed API keys, unencrypted KV/D1 bindings, missing CORS headers, and x402 readiness.
- **Request Body JSON:**
  ```json
  {
    "wrangler_config": "{\"name\": \"my-worker\", \"main\": \"src/index.ts\", \"vars\": {\"API_KEY\": \"sk_live_12345\"}}",
    "worker_code": "export default { async fetch(req) { ... } }"
  }
  ```
- **Response Output JSON:** Contains `audit_passed`, `vulnerabilities` array, `wrangler_score`, and `remediation_steps`.

---

### Tool 4: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC ML-KEM-768 / Kyber) Vault Guard (`/v1/tools/crypto.vault`)
- **Provider:** WebCrypto PQC Edge Isolate
- **Price:** $0.05 USDC
- **Functionality:** Provides Post-Quantum Cryptographic envelope encryption (NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 Kyber + NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-87 Dilithium lattice signatures) and PII scanning for AI agents so sensitive financial data, private keys, or credentials are quantum-proof against "Harvest Now, Decrypt Later" quantum attack vectors.
- **Request Body JSON:**
  ```json
  {
    "action": "encrypt",
    "payload": "user_credit_card_or_private_key_string",
    "mask_pii": true
  }
  ```
- **Response Output JSON:** Contains `encrypted_ciphertext`, `iv`, `auth_tag`, `pii_detected` list, and `hash`.

---

### Tool 5: OpenDesign UI Spec & Tailwind Token Generator (`/v1/tools/design.402`)
- **Provider:** OpenDesign DeepSeek UI Engine
- **Price:** $0.05 USDC
- **Functionality:** Converts high-level product descriptions into structured Tailwind CSS design systems, atomic component hierarchies, SVG branding/logo specifications, and x402 payment modal wireframes.
- **Request Body JSON:**
  ```json
  {
    "product_name": "ScrapeEngine x402",
    "theme": "dark-futuristic-cyan",
    "requested_components": ["HeroSection", "PricingCard", "PaymentModal"]
  }
  ```
- **Response Output JSON:** Contains `design_tokens` (colors, typography, spacing), `component_trees`, and `tailwind_jsx`.

---

### Tool 6: Workers AI Edge Model Chat (`/v1/tools/nemotron.chat`)
- **Provider:** Cloudflare Workers AI (`@cf/openai/gpt-6-astra`, `@cf/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`, `@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast`, `@cf/nvidia/nemotron-3-120b-a12b`)
- **Price:** $0.05 USDC
- **Functionality:** Direct sub-20ms edge LLM proxy for autonomous AI agents requiring raw text completion or structured agent prompts. Accepts any `@cf/...` Cloudflare Workers AI model identifier.
- **Request Body JSON:**
  ```json
  {
    "model": "@cf/openai/gpt-6-astra",
    "prompt": "Explain the x402 payment flow in 3 concise bullet points.",
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "temperature": 0.3
  }
  ```
- **Response Output JSON:** Contains `result` (generated text), `usage` (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens), and `model`.

## 5. Smart Contract Architecture (`X402PaymentGateway.sol`)

The EVM gateway smart contract source code is stored at `/contracts/X402PaymentGateway.sol`.

Key features of the smart contract:
- **Direct Settlement:** Transfers ERC20 tokens directly from the payer to the beneficiary (`0x003cC678764C8143a4b92370acB40e3B41319016`) without lockups.
- **Native GAS Support:** `payForCallNative(bytes32 requestId)` accepts native ETH / POL / CELO.
- **EIP-2612 Gasless Permits:** `payWithPermit(...)` allows AI agents to submit signed payment authorizations without paying native gas fees.
- **Replay Protection:** `usedNonces[requestId]` mapping prevents double-spending or replay attacks across HTTP request IDs.

---

## 6. Token Caps, Quotas & Overrun Protection Rules

To protect AI agents and gateway operators from budget overruns, the gateway enforces mathematically calculated token & execution caps:

1. **Token Headroom Calculation Formula:**
   $$\text{Funded Tokens Total} = \left\lfloor \frac{\text{Prepaid Deposit USD}}{\text{Base Cost Per 1k Tokens (\$0.001)}} \right\rfloor \times 1000$$
2. **Per-Request Hard Cap:** Every API call is hard-capped at **4,096 max generated tokens**.
3. **CPU Execution Timeout:** Cloudflare Worker CPU execution time is strictly capped at **30,000 ms** per call.
4. **Prepaid Plan Endpoint (`/v1/plan`):** Agents can query `/v1/plan?deposit_usd=1.00&window_minutes=60` to inspect their rate caps (TPM/RPM) before issuing tool calls.

---

## 7. How Autonomous AI Agents Consume x402 Services

### Python SDK Integration Example
```python
import requests

GATEWAY_URL = "https://aifoundry.pages.dev/v1/tools/openspec.plan"
BENEFICIARY = "0x003cC678764C8143a4b92370acB40e3B41319016"

# Step 1: Probe Gateway
res = requests.post(GATEWAY_URL, json={"goal": "Build an AI agent network"})

if res.status_code == 402:
    price_usd = res.headers.get("X-402-Price-USD")
    pay_to = res.headers.get("X-402-Pay-To")
    print(f"Payment required: ${price_usd} USDC to {pay_to}")

    # Step 2: Execute $0.05 USDC payment transaction on Base or EVM
    tx_hash = "tx_0x8f32c0d9a1e4b..."  # Simulated or web3 transaction hash

    # Step 3: Re-issue request with payment proof header
    paid_res = requests.post(
        GATEWAY_URL,
        headers={"X-402-Payment": tx_hash},
        json={"goal": "Build an AI agent network"}
    )
    print("Tool Result:", paid_res.json())
```

### cURL Quick Test Command
```bash
# Challenge Test (Expects 402 Payment Required)
curl -i -X POST "https://aifoundry.pages.dev/v1/tools/nemotron.chat" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "Hello x402 gateway!"}'

# Paid Test (Simulated Settlement Header)
curl -X POST "https://aifoundry.pages.dev/v1/tools/nemotron.chat" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-402-Payment: tx_0x_settled_usdc_003cC678764C8143a4b92370acB40e3B41319016" \
  -d '{"prompt": "Generate a concise architecture overview."}'
```
